主要内容: BROOKFIELD ASSET MANAGEMENT INC. completed a tender offer for GrafTech International Ltd. shares, which expired on August 13, 2015. Approximately 83.4% of the company's outstanding shares were tendered, with 116,266,327 shares accepted. The tendered shares, along with shares owned by the Purchaser and Acquisition Sub, represented about 86.4% of the company's shares outstanding, satisfying the merger conditions. All accepted shares will be paid in cash at $5.05 per share, matching the tender offer price. The merger will result in GrafTech becoming a wholly-owned subsidiary of the Purchaser, with its common stock delisted from the NYSE. Convertible preferred stock owned by the Purchaser or Acquisition Sub will be canceled post-merger. Securities explicitly mentioned in the source include GTI.
